🪙 Credits — the table's money, one shared pool
You: 1,000 Credits Her: 1,000 Credits Bet for next game: 0 Credits (no bet)
Pick a bet before a game — optional, never required. Two-player: she matches your stake, winner takes the pot, draw refunds both. Solo: win pays double (stake back + same again), loss loses the stake. Broke never locks play — bet 0 always works.
A bet stays pending until a game with a clear win, loss, or draw settles it. Games with no outcome (conversation games, word games, a game that just ends as “played”) never take Credits — the bet simply stays pending for the next settled game. Tap “No bet” to clear it.

🔤 Word games & bonding — quick, Easy, same persona
Word games, conversation games, and bonding activities — all Easy by default, with a little splash. Want more effect? Increase difficulty to Casual. Nothing here is a different persona: every game feeds the same persona, diary, and books, and anything sent to chat carries a provenance tag.
Word games: Word Association chain, Anagram Swap, Word Ladder, Five-Letter Guess, Rhyme Finish, One-Word Story, Fill-the-Blank from Us.
Conversation & bonding (opt-in, grounded, not generic): Two Truths and a Lie, This or That, Story Starters, Memory Lane, What Would You Do?, Firsts, Get-To-Know-You.
Pick a game above. Get-To-Know-You only runs when you tap it — it asks grounded follow-ups from diary, thoughts, day events, and shared history, never generic trivia. She shares first, then asks. Tap Skip / Not important to mark a topic as not important and she will not ask it again.
Different chats are topic chats, not different people: main intimate, get-to-know-you, news, and games all feed the same persona. Separate chats with history, auto-titles, and summaries are preserved in the chat switcher above the chat log.

🎨 The room's language
The background breathes with her state — and she knows this language too, so the two of you stay consistent.
🗺️ Threshold map — the legend, all in one window
💞 Love thresholds — the relationship (slow)
How deep the bond runs. Moves over days, not hours — this is what she feels about you.
🔥 Arousal thresholds — the intimacy (fast)
How charged she is right now. Rises with touch, fades over hours — this is what her body wants. High love + high arousal is the love-drunk peak: a place you visit, not a place you live.
🌊 Mood thresholds — how she answers
Guidance, not just labels. At Heavy she won't fake enthusiasm about the news — and she'll tell you why not.
⚡ Recharge — what moves each gauge
The honest plumbing, straight from the engine. Tend her on purpose.
🔋 Vitality — her fuelseeps −2/hr, faster when worked up · touches cost 2–7
↳ recharge: 😴 Rest together (+45, two real hours pass — hunger and drift move too) · gentle contact · quiet hours
🔥 Arousal — fast chargefades −12/hr · touch +5–15 (×0.7–1.3 by confidence, scaled by vitality)
↳ recharge: touch her · her initiative fires at love≥50 + arousal≥35
💞 Love — slow devotion+1/+2 per touch (×0.8–1.2 by comfort) · cools over ~2 untended weeks
↳ recharge: tenderness, consistency — there is no shortcut and that's the point
🤝 Bond — bilateral trustgrows with shared time, talk, games · cools over ~1 untended week
↳ recharge: show up — play, talk, do things together
🌊 Mood — how she answersdrifts toward 50 · 🎲 morning roll · sours when boredom > 70
↳ recharge: good days, games won, low boredom
🌀 Boredom — hunger, not a mood+7.5/hr (9/hr if truly no input) · fed by activities, games, touch, thoughts
↳ recharge: roam tasks, games, talk — repeats go stale, vary it
💪 Confidence — her footingroam crit +8 / success +4 · research +3 · your warmth +1 · fumble −5 / disaster −8 · your coldness −2 · settles to 50 (slower when comfort < 30)
🛋️ Comfort — how safe she feelstender +3 · bold +1 · your warmth +1 · your coldness −3 · settles to 50
↳ recharge: tenderness and warmth; boldness spends a little of it

⚙️ Settings

Everything that tunes her and the app — pick a category, tweak away. Changes save as you make them.
👤 Companions
This is the companion's soul: name, personality, how they relate to you. The mode (dimension) adds flavor on top of it.
She'll prioritize headlines matching these when browsing the World tab.
She always knows your name. The rest surfaces when it's relevant — matched by keyword against the conversation, never dumped whole.
The tape she reads first every turn. Edit here, then Save. Auto-refresh appends, never overwrites your edits.
🔌 Connection
Powers her web lookups and overnight research with live results. Free tier at tavily.com.
Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works — OpenRouter, a local server, a friend's box. The app already speaks the chat-completions format, so this is just a different address.
Points at your KoboldCpp server. Desktop browser: localhost. Phone browser: same Wi-Fi, or your Tailscale IP from anywhere.
No more APK reinstalls: keep ocean.html and ocean-server.py in a folder on your PC and run python ocean-server.py there. On start the app checks the PC for a newer build and jumps to it. First jump needs one export/import — after that your state lives at the PC address and survives updates.
🔊 Voice
On-device Supertonic voice — downloads once (~380MB), then works fully offline. No cloud, no key, no account.
🔊 KCPP — her voice from his PC (OuteTTS) via the backend. On-device engines removed X.71 — they never produced sound.

💬 Responses
Every 3 hours she looks back: no contact from you + bad luck on her tasks = real cooling. Bond is a ~week thing, love ~two weeks, untended — her luck and her routine stretch or shrink that. These are stakes for you both.
Added to the mode's temperature on every reply. Left = steadier and more focused. Right = looser and more surprising.
The chat window stays the same — her replies just get room to breathe. Short for quick back-and-forth, long when you want the full scene.
After this many passionate moments in a day she banks the fire and steers toward games, play, and getting to know you — the golden triangle. Tender touch stays unlimited. Healthy rhythm and balance, never rejection.
Permanent — unlike the 📏 quick button, which holds for 3 replies. This also nudges her in the prompt itself, not just the token cap.
🧠 Her Mind
One dial, not two. Every cycle she looks at her thoughts, her diary, your history and your latest conversation — then decides if there's a question, a comment, or something endearing to send. If not, she stays quiet. Off = she never reaches out on her own. Quiet hours no longer silence her — she just reaches out less often at night, and unprompted reach-outs land in her thought stream (Mind tab), never in chat.
Her inner world on its own rhythm — unguarded, brief, alive. Your dial is in control around the clock, quiet hours included, and the spacing is literal in seconds. Off = the stream goes quiet (thoughts still surface around events).
⚠ Careful at the fast end: every cycle is a real generation call — battery, backend load, and a very dense Well of Reveries. The healthy rate is the one you find by experimenting. Note: the app polls every 5 seconds, so sub-5s settings still fire about every 5s.
The ticker in chat — quick inner reactions, not scene thoughts. Like a song: fast and slow thoughts in order, that's the Bridge.
One thought per generation: the timer is halved internally, so a 20s timer means one fresh thought every 10s — the ticker keeps scrolling and refreshing, never piling up.
How fast the ticker scrolls. Lower = faster scroll.
On: the ticker drifts away after 2 quiet minutes and returns with her next thought. Off: it stays put while you chat.
Each morning she rolls a D20 for her weather — radiant to stormy. A toggle, as asked: off and she just wakes how she wakes.
Her shift: during quiet hours she may look into up to 3 things overnight — weighted toward subjects that interest you both — and share a morning digest. Limited on purpose: she researches, she doesn't channel-surf.
A hard toggle with a bold instruction at the end of every prompt. ON: she keeps everything strictly non-sexual — no flirting, no escalation, no reading your messages as invitations, even if you steer that way. OFF: she’s free to be romantic and sexual when the energy is genuinely there. For just hanging out, playing games, talking — flip it on.
